help --help.stdout:
Converts CSV data to Markdown tables
(c) 2014-2026 by Philipp Staender, MIT License

Usage: csv2md [options] <csvfile>

Options:
      --version           Show version number                          [boolean]
  -p, --pretty            pretty output, i.e. optimized column width and not
                          inline-style                                 [boolean]
      --csvComment        ignore everything until next line after this character
      --tableDelimiter    delimiter for cells in output           [default: "|"]
      --cellPadding       chars / spaces to wrap cell content     [default: " "]
      --firstLineMarker   to seperate first row
                          you can specifiy own characters, for instance:
                          `-*` -> `------…` (gets cell width)
                          `-====-` -> `-====-`
                                                                 [default: "-*"]
      --delimiterOnBegin  first row delimiter                      [default: ""]
      --delimiterOnEnd    last row delimiter                       [default: ""]
      --parallel          number of transformation callbacks to run in parallel
                                                         [number] [default: 100]
      --csvDelimiter      column delimiter
      --csvQuote          cell quote
      --csvEscape         char to escape, see quoter
  -h, --help              Show help                                    [boolean]

Examples:
  csv2md -p data.csv > output.md          Converts csv to pretty markdown table
  cat data.csv | csv2md > output.md       Converts larger data
  csv2md --csvDelimiter=";" < ~/data.csv  Converts with a distinct csv delimiter
